name: BRAND TEXT
description:
The lighting of the sauna is an important detail, which provides half of the relaxing effect in the sauna room. LED lighting will enable you to experience fabulous sensations while visiting sauna. LED is a good alternative to fiber optic lighting. This type of lighting has a wide range of applications. It can be used under the ceiling of the sauna in the form of the starry sky, or installed along the wall in order to accentuate the texture of stone or wood, or under the backrest.



The lighting can also be used for the illumination of any other building. The set includes 12 LED lamps with heads, 5 metres of cable to each lamp, and the adapter. The colour of the lighting is cold white. The lighting has the property of directed emission with the scattering angle of 35.
